'''Adiss's ship''' was a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] used by the [[Yuvernian/Legends|Yuvernian]] [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Cane Adiss/Legends|Cane Adiss]]. Adiss's vessel was spacious enough to accommodate the Yuvernian's large body and was present in the [[Yuvern system/Legends|Yuvern system]] during the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] [[Battle in the Yuvern system|attack]] on the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Oplovis Sector Fleet]].<ref name="DB">{{DB|character|caneadiss|Adiss, Cane}}</ref>
